paging.after.gone: after "{after}" is not in the list (it was removed or renamed). The answer goes on from what comes next in the order
paging.after.goneFromTop: after "{after}" is not in the list (it was removed, renamed or moved). The answer starts from the top (it includes what was read before)
paging.after.shape: after must be the next of the previous answer (a string or a number; the answer goes on from the one after it)
paging.limit.count: limit must be a count from 1 to {most}
